ops.title: design and implement cross-entry signal aggregation
ops.description:
Signal scores never aggregate across window entries: `PrimitiveState.match_signals` (captain_hook/state.py:119-130) thresholds per entry. Tells split across two assistant messages that each score below threshold produce no fire even when their sum crosses it. Pinned as a constructed miss in the split-message test added in round 4 (tests/test_wall_of_text_f08.py: S2=1 and S3=2 split across two messages, threshold 3). No live failing case exists — f05 passes because its second message alone scores 4. User decision (round 5): design aggregation now rather than waiting for a live case.

## Plan

1. DESIGN FIRST — check back with the user on the design before implementing. This is a hard gate, not optional. Open semantics to resolve:
   - Sum across window entries vs per-signal presence: does the same pattern matching in N entries count once or N times?
   - Consumed-hash granularity: an aggregate fire must define which entry texts get consumed (all contributors, or only the tipping entry?).
   - Interplay with `window="turn"` vs fixed windows (fixed windows count raw JSONL events — crowd-out caveat in the captain_hook/signals/__init__.py docstring), and with the UserPromptSubmit prompt entry (8.5.0 scans [prompt, *window]).
   - Whether per-entry firing remains a fast path so existing behavior is a strict subset of the new behavior.
2. Implement; flip the pinned split-message test from documents-miss to fires; add cross-entry harness shapes.
3. Regression net: the three consumer suites (cc-context / cc-notes / show) before and after; every newly-firing case dispositioned — thresholds were tuned per-entry, expect retuning. Codex refuter over the diff.
4. Release the next capt-hook version via the tag pipeline; re-verify tags AND PyPI immediately before tagging (releases raced twice in round 4: v8.4.1 and cc-notes 0.17.0 both landed from parallel sessions mid-round).

## Caveat

Aggregation changes every signal-scored hook's effective sensitivity, ecosystem-wide — that is why the design check-back is a hard gate.

ops.text: Aggregation design reviewed with the user before any implementation lands
Pinned split-message test in tests/test_wall_of_text_f08.py flipped from documents-miss to fires
cc-context, cc-notes, and show consumer suites green pre/post with every newly-firing case dispositioned
Released via tag pipeline with tag and PyPI re-verified at tag time
